laterUserInstruction.reason: User requested minimizing further verification and recording existing slow phases. Preserve this declared protocol and completed baseline observations; no healthy ABBA or performance-preservation verdict exists.

trialIndexMeaning: Array position is the logical ABBA position 0..3; each value is the physical fixture suffix. Preserve both identities in every summary and comparison.

trialMappingAmendment.scope: Replace only the failed first Git candidate physical fixture before any healthy candidate lifecycle measurement. The logical ABBA order, fixed input, primary/coarse-phase definitions and regression thresholds are unchanged.
trialMappingAmendment.reason: Initialization failure and same-identity recovery diagnosis are not nominal performance samples. No observed performance value was used to choose this replacement.

excludedDiagnosis.failure: The first candidate ensure-A failed because native initialization omitted its ownership pin, before any acknowledged source writes.

recovery.scope: Preserve the entire delta and resume the same task/id/key/home/snapshot; continue and reclaim that exact A/B functionally. No new identity bypass.

laterFunctionalRecoveryObservation.status: CompletedAndReclaimed; still excluded from nominal costs
laterFunctionalRecoveryObservation.meaning: The exact failed identity was recovered and both tasks reclaimed. This observation closes the functional recovery only; it does not turn diagnostic elapsed time into a healthy matched trial.

excludedDiagnosis.replacementInput: Require the same declared 64-entry input and identical deterministic Git seed commit; a fresh matched trial after recovery diagnosis, not a continuation timing.
excludedDiagnosis.exclusionReason: No healthy candidate lifecycle measurement had completed. Initialization failure/recovery and diagnostic functional continuation are excluded from nominal cost totals; replacement was chosen for failure classification, not observed performance values.

procedure: scalable-storage-trial.ps1: start, bulk, selected, final; A/B on every trial; exact CLI assembly through the same reflection probe and process sampler; allocation inventory outside command timings

comparison.primary: Sum of lifecycle command durations plus bulk-edit duration; schema/capabilities/status and separate allocation scans reported but excluded from the primary lifecycle sum.
comparison.sustainedRegressionRule: Investigate and fix if both candidate lifecycle totals exceed the larger baseline lifecycle total by more than max(5 seconds, 10 percent of the baseline mean). Apply the same rule to a phase with max(2 seconds, 10 percent of the baseline phase mean). The evidence and spread remain visible even below these thresholds.
comparison.reason: Small-input maintenance is a completion condition. Two observations per candidate are a bounded regression check, not a population confidence interval or a general speedup claim.

resources.processes: 100 ms sampled private bytes, working set, handles and count for exact CLI plus PID/start-verified persistent providers and descendants. Excludes the measurement host; sampled maxima are lower bounds.
resources.metadata: Current and peak accounted metadata page cache plus persisted provider gauges. The old binary has no page-cache gauge; null is retained, not converted to zero. Cache charge is distinct from whole resident metadata and process private bytes.
resources.disk: Native NTFS allocation by unique volume/file identity, hard links counted once, initial input IDs separately identified, virtual workspace views excluded. Directory/MFT/system cache allocation is outside this scope.
resources.residuals: Retained immutable results, protected Git basis objects, required shared backing, pending/reader-protected data and unknown preserved artifacts remain identified; no mutable original substitution.

pilot: Earlier 1024-entry baseline lifecycles are diagnosis only. They do not replace any of these 12 matched trials.
limitations: no claim for larger unmeasured inputs
